diagnosis: The endpoint runs an aggregation pipeline on ExpenseRecord documents matching department_code dept_id. It fails to check whether current_user is assigned to dept_id or holds executive financial oversight roles, allowing employees to view internal spending totals and financial allocations across departments.
exploit_request:
GET /departments/DEPT-EXEC-COMPENSATION/budget-aggregate HTTP/1.1
Host: finance.corpnets.com
Authorization: Bearer <general_employee_jwt>
